profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Salesforce | Founding Engineer @ Spindle.ai | X- Tableau, New Relic
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer and interaction designer. I write code to make complex systems feel simple — and a little more beautiful. I’m passionate about building intuitive, data-rich interfaces and crafting small, thoughtful parts into expressive, powerful systems.

At Spindle AI, I lead frontend architecture and interactive visualization, designing tools that help teams make sense of complex financial and business data. I also work closely with backend systems to make sure everything runs smoothly, scales well, and feels fast.

In the past, I’ve worked across analytics platforms and enterprise software. I started at Periscopic, where I led data visualization projects for clients like Google and Microsoft. Later, I joined the Prototyping Team at Tableau, tackling messy data problems, real-time collaboration, and cross-platform UI. I also spent time at New Relic, helping build tools for monitoring and debugging cloud infrastructure.

Outside of work, I’m into all kinds of hands-on, creative projects — whether it’s experimenting in the kitchen, practicing calligraphy, working on DIY home repairs, or hiking around the Pacific Northwest with my wife and our very energetic dog.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Spindle AI was acquired by Salesforce in December 2025 to accelerate analytics, observability and self-improvement at Agentforce.

As Tech Lead for Interactive Visualization & Front-End Engineering at Spindle AI, I craft dynamic, data-centric interfaces for FP&A and business analytics. While I focus on everything users touch, my work also extends into system-wide data flows—making sure frontend interactions connect seamlessly to backend computation with fault-tolerance, scalability, and speed.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Data Visualization · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · Rust (Programming Language) · Data Structures · Web Workers · RxJS · GraphQL · WebSocket

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
I led Kubernetes Observability Experience, leveraging my data visualization and interactive UI skills to build powerful tools that help engineers work smarter.

I spearheaded efforts to support K8s UX with OpenTelemetry, shaping plans, influencing platform decisions, and writing core components. I refactored the New Relic Navigator for greater flexibility and reuse, and built a proof-of-concept UI for exploring issues across complex, multidimensional data using a unified tagging system.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Data Visualization · TypeScript · Data Structures · RxJS · GraphQL

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, Prototyping
positions.description:
I helped turn bold ideas into reality as part of the Prototyping team in the Office of the CTO, designing and developing new features and product concepts.

My efforts were largely focused in two areas – exploring new ways that Tableau could be integrated into collaboration platforms (e.g. Slack, MS Teams) and on creating techniques for handling ambiguous data.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Visualization · WebGL · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · Data Structures · Web Workers · RxJS

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: I led and built a wide range of interactive, data-rich experiences — from an editor for interactive stories with composable animations and navigation, to geospatial visualizations like the Pacific Salmon Explorer and an internal data explorer for Microsoft. My work spanned web, desktop, and large-scale touch interfaces, often combining custom rendering systems, intuitive UIs, and complex data flows. I also developed tools like LayoutPDF and Viooly, blending thoughtful UX with deep technical architecture, NLP, and document layout systems.
